role: District Representative · Iloilo City, Lone District
summary: Iloilo City representative with 96 principal-authored bills. Only three surfaced under rubric topics: limited presidential authority to suspend petroleum taxes, an anti-dynasty ban and a clarification of heirs for death benefits. No dimension reaches two adequately evidenced issues.
caveat: Large bill portfolio but only three rubric-relevant bills surfaced; the others were not individually reviewed.
